transcript.text: Today I am building Creator Duty live because creators should be present with their audience, not tab-switching through an operations checklist.
The agent sees the livestream event, plans the campaign, makes a vertical promo, and writes a version for each channel without waiting for another prompt.
The interesting part is not writing copy. It is safe action: deterministic policy, immutable releases, idempotency, receipts, and recovering one failed destination without duplicating the others.
Pub/Sub delivers the event, Cloud Run owns the workflow, Gemini makes bounded campaign choices, and Firestore preserves every checkpoint.
I can stay live because Creator Duty handles the campaign. That is the product promise and the operational result.
